queries_run: Grab Holdings market share gaining OR losing 2026 GoTo Indonesia ride-hailing food delivery
Grab new entrant threat Southeast Asia 2026 Xanh SM Bolt Shopee food delivery competition

findings.claim: 20-F 列出各板塊競爭者：外送有 Foodpanda、ShopeeFood、Gojek（主要印尼）、Line Man Wongnai；叫車有 Gojek、Be、Bolt、Tada、Ryde、Xanh SM、Maxim、InDrive 等；支付有 ShopeePay、Google Pay、Dana、GoPay 等。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In our deliveries segment, we face competition from regional players such as Foodpanda, ShopeeFood and Gojek (primarily in Indonesia) and single market players in Southeast Asia, including Line Man Wongnai in Thailand.

findings.claim: 20-F 指出競爭者包含新進入者，且法規變動可能便利本地與外國競爭者進入。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: These competitors may be well-established or new entrants and focused on providing low-cost alternatives or higher quality offerings, or any combination thereof.

findings.claim: 新加坡 CCS 初步認定 Grab 收購 Trans-cab 會強化其叫車市場支配地位，Grab 於 2024 年 7 月終止收購。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: in July 2024, following a provisional decision by the CCS that our proposed acquisition of Trans-cab Holdings Ltd was likely to entrench and strengthen our dominant position in the ride-hailing market, and result in a substantial lessening of competition in the ride-hailing market, we terminated the acquisition and withdrew our application for merger approval.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到具體份額消長數字（搜尋僅得聚合站摘要，無可逐字複製原文）；搜尋摘要提及 Grab–GoTo 併購傳聞與 Xanh SM 擴張，但無可核實原文，未列入。

clues.claim: Xanh SM 為越南唯一主要替代者，GoTo 2024 年起退出越南；報導 Grab 與 GoTo 洽談約 70 億美元併購。
